items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: And my grandmother's second marriage, she married a Portuguese. His name was Ardway Chalut. I mean, Papa Joey, as we called him

ctx.x: Did you say after your grandmother, you were telling your grandfather Creole and your grandmother white, or how was it?

No, my grandmother was white, and my grandfather was a Creole, my mother's father. And my grandmother's second marriage, she married a Portuguese. His name was Ardway Chalut. Her last two children were for this Portuguese. I mean, Papa Joey, as we called him, because his name was Ardway Chalute. I wouldn't know how to spell that.
No, I wouldn't either. Portuguese names would be hard to spell.
